posts.text: Rock & Roll Hall of Famers in the house tonight! No joke—that’s Steve Holly from Paul McCartney & Wings playing those drums with The Sidney Green Street Band. Playing until 11:00, so come on by!
The Turkey can Thaw without you. Shillelagh Club is the place to be on Thanksgiving Eve!
Big Thank you to all our great customers that left a review...most recently, Patrick and Jewel. Haven't checked us out? What are you waiting for?
